verdicts.take: Still the best Fallout. Fight me.
Never drop the soap. I learned that the hard way. Twice.
Survived the ocean, sharks, and my own building skills.
Settlements ate more of my life than the main story did.
Great game. Terrible coworkers. I'm the terrible coworker.
